hold_text: Tier-2 deploy (new systemd units and OnFailure= drop-ins installed on the live VM by scripts/install_systemd_units.sh, a new hourly live-VM timer). Approval sought from the manager (acting with the operator's authority) to merge; the manager reviews and merges. The audit brief (FIX-SA-08/FIX-SA-12) is the dispatching record.
why: FIX-SA-08 + the alarm half of FIX-SA-12 (docs/audits/system-audit-2026-09-29.md § 5, SA-AUD-5). (1) OnFailure=ict-notify-failure@%n.service as a drop-in on the 18 Type=oneshot units that sit behind a deploy/ timer (count from tests/test_install_systemd_units.sh, run over the real deploy/ tree; excludes ict-trainer-git-sync, ict-heartbeat, ict-ib-gateway-*). Drop-ins only, no unit file edited, nothing restarted; ict-trader-live is a long-running simple unit and is not selected. The notifier logs every failure and pings at most once per unit per 6 h. (2) deploy/trainer/ gains the 4 cloud-init-only trainer unit pairs, extracted from what is INSTALLED (8 of 8 sha256 prefixes equal the trainer's, trainer-diag #14150 vs local). (3) ict-trainer-disk-alarm.timer (hourly) pings at >= 90% used from the published mirror, ok/alarm/unknown distinct. NOT DONE HERE, deliberately: the audit's 'add 5 units to the diag allowlist' - all five are already exempted with reasons in scripts/check_diag_unit_allowlist.py EXEMPT (retired, gateway-VM, one-shot), so they are unreadable by design, not by omission. Merging any src/ or deploy/ change triggers the standard git-sync deploy, which restarts ict-trader-live; the merger should choose the moment.
